content.h1: SeaNeB News Press Kit | Media & Partnership Information
content.intro: SeaNeB News is a fast-growing digital and hyperlocal news platform in India focused on delivering verified city-wise, district-level, and national news updates.
content.mission: To create a trusted digital ecosystem where local journalism thrives, misinformation is reduced, and communities receive verified news that truly impacts their daily lives.

features.title: Hyperlocal Focus
features.desc: We prioritize city and district-level reporting.

features.title: Open Publishing Model
features.desc: Verified contributors can publish directly after approval.

features.title: Editorial Review System
features.desc: Every story undergoes screening before publication.

features.title: Free & Accessible
features.desc: SeaNeB News is free for readers across India.

faqs.a: SeaNeB News is a digital hyperlocal news platform in India that publishes verified city-wise, district-level, and national news updates.
SeaNeB focuses on hyperlocal reporting and allows verified independent journalists to publish after review.
